how.title: Indlela yokuguqula
how.step1.title: Khetha ifayela lakho
how.step1.text: Cindezela Khetha amafayela noma uhudule amafayela ebhokisini elingenhla. Ifayela elilodwa noma amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa.
how.step2.title: Khetha ifomethi
how.step2.text: Khetha ifomethi okuhloswe ngayo yefayela ngalinye, bese ucindezela Guqula.
how.step3.title: Londoloza umphumela
how.step3.text: Uma sekuqediwe, cindezela Landa ukuze ulondoloze ifayela kudivayisi yakho.
formats.title: Amafomethi asekelwayo
formats.lead: Amakhulu ezinhlanganisela zokuguqula zazo zonke izinhlobo zamafayela ezivame kakhulu:
faq.title: Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa
faq.a1: Yebo, imahhala ngokuphelele. Akudingeki ukubhalisa, ukungena ngemvume noma uhlelo lokusebenza.
faq.a2: Cha. Konke ukuguqulwa kwenzeka ngqo kusiphequluli sakho, ngakho amafayela akho awalokhu ayishiye idivayisi yakho. Yingakho futhi kushesha futhi kuyimfihlo.
faq.a3: Izithombe (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, GIF, BMP, ICO, SVG, TIFF, AVIF), ividiyo (MP4, WEBM, MOV, MKV, AVI, njll.), umsindo (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OPUS), amadokhumenti (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML), amaspredishithi (XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, TSV), idatha (JSON, YAML, XML) nezingobo zomlando ze-ZIP. Noma yiliphi elinye ifayela lisengacindezelwa libe yi-ZIP noma liguqulwe libe yi-Base64.
faq.a4: Ividiyo icutshungulwa yinjini yokuguqula ngaphakathi kusiphequluli sakho, ngakho ijubane lincike kudivayisi yakho. Uma kushintsha isiqukathi kuphela (isibonelo MP4 kuya ku-MKV), sikopisha ukusakaza kwevidiyo ngaphandle kokuyibhala kabusha, ngakho kucishe kube ngokushesha.
faq.a5: Khetha ifayela le-PDF, bese ukhetha PNG noma JPG. Ikhasi ngalinye liba yisithombe esisodwa, futhi ungazilanda zonke ngesikhathi esisodwa njenge-ZIP.
faq.a6: Hhayi kithina. Umkhawulo kuphela yinkumbulo yedivayisi yakho. Kumavidiyo angaphezu kuka-1–2 GB, ikhompyutha isebenza kangcono.
